text: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰19日晚在钓鱼台国宾馆会见金融监管总局国际咨询委员会委员时表示，中国正全面落实“十五五”规划纲要，将继续坚定不移扩大金融领域高水平对外开放，加快建设金融强国。欢迎更多外资金融机构来华投资兴业，深化对华合作，为中国式现代化建设提供高质量金融服务。金融监管总局国际咨询委员会委员表示，对中国深化金融改革开放充满期待，看好中国经济和金融发展前景，将持续扩大对华投资合作。（新华社）
text_en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, said on the evening of the 19th when meeting with the International Advisory Council of the National Financial Regulatory Administration at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse that China is fully implementing the outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan and will continue to unswervingly expand high-level opening-up in the financial sector and accelerate the building of a financial powerhouse. More foreign financial institutions are welcome to invest and do business in China, deepen cooperation with China, and provide high-quality financial services for Chinese-style modernization. Members of the International Advisory Council of the National Financial Regulatory Administration said they are full of expectations for China's deepening of financial reform and opening-up, are optimistic about the prospects of China's economy and financial development, and will continue to expand investment and cooperation with China. (Xinhua)
